note: Regenerate with scripts/release/record-release-hashes.sh, and only at a commit that is ALREADY on main. A commit recorded from a feature branch stops existing the moment that branch is squash merged, and the manifest is then pinned to a SHA nobody can check out: that is issue #174, which is why the script refuses to record a commit that is not reachable from a rewrite-free ref and why distribution/packaging's release-manifest-integrity check re-asks the same question on every run. binary_sha256 is hashed from the two binaries extracted out of the built image, so it is real evidence of what was compiled, and scripts/release/verify-manifest-parity.sh rebuilds and re-hashes them before any push, so a manifest describing different bytes cannot be published (#260). registry_digest is what ghcr.io assigned each architecture's manifest on the 0.1.0 push, read back with docker buildx imagetools inspect rather than taken from the push's own output: the push says what it believes it sent and the registry says what it holds. index_digest is the multi-architecture image index those two sit under, and it is what cosign signed and attached the SBOM attestation to. local_image_id_sha256 is none of these: it is the local Docker image ID the recording build produced, which identifies the image on the machine that built it and nowhere else. Deploy by digest, never by tag.
